items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: And the one guy that was close to the New Orleans drummers, and he was very good, that was Sid Kaplan.

ctx.x: Yeah. None of them. See. Now, our voice drummers around New Orleans was better than some of the best ones that we had up there. See. And the one guy that was close to the New Orleans drummers, and he was very good, that was Sid Kaplan. Yeah. Well, he ran with Paul and those guys. Paul Bobbin was a very good drummer. But when I went home playing with his brother, I thought his brother was better drumming than him. He's just a little Bob. Yeah.
Good musical family. The whole family is good music.
